title: Pierre Deligne Papers: Modern LaTeX Drafts and English Translation Drafts
version: 2026-06-01 Deligne working record: Paper 001 refresh and Weil 1969 letter
description:
Dedicated Deligne record for the Modern LaTeX Editions of Mathematics Manuscripts project. This page is separate from the main corpus so Deligne material can be cited, revised, or reorganized independently.

The top-level files are reader-facing: cumulative English and French/working-LaTeX readers, individual English paper PDFs, selected French source/working PDFs, and separate correspondence items. Reference scans, TeX, source folders, and checking material are kept in ZIP files rather than cluttering the front-facing reader list.

Status at a glance. [######----] active touched-paper stream: 19 paper-level English working translations are in the current cumulative reader; [#######---] correspondence stream: 11 Deligne letters are available in English and French working PDFs; [####------] French source or working-LaTeX top-level readers are present for 24 selected papers/letters, with broader original/reference material preserved in ZIP artifacts. These are working scholarly transcriptions and translation drafts, not proofed critical editions.

Latest update. Refreshed Paper 001 and added the Deligne-to-Weil 1969 letter. The Papers 001-005 source packet is preserved in artifacts; Paper 005 remains flagged there as partial/checking material rather than promoted over the existing front-facing file.
